$schema_note: Seeded during spec-map.json bootstrap: every spec-current.json property/enum-member on a mapped construct (see spec-map.json) that the SDK does not yet model, excluding refund_wallet_address (added by this PR on QuoteIn -> quotes.CreateParams) and the banking_partner 'portage' member (added by this PR on BankingPartner). properties[].schema is normally a spec-current.json component schema name (matching spec-map.json's top-level 'spec' key); for a property that lives inside a types[].nested sub-object, schema is instead that nested mapping's SDK symbol name (e.g. 'TrackingPayment'), since one inline sub-object can be nested under several parent schemas (PayoutOut, PayoutOnEvmOut, and the 4 payout webhook schemas all carry the same tracking_payment shape) and the SDK symbol is the unambiguous anchor. Either way this is spec/SDK-symbol-centric, not SDK package.Type -- unlike .api-sync/contract-allowlist.json, which is keyed by SDK package.Type for cmd/contractcheck's SDK-field-centric model. cmd/apisync -check treats every entry here as satisfied regardless of spec-current.json content; removing an entry re-exposes that gap to reconciliation. enum_coverage[] (checkEnumCoverage) and nested_objects[] (checkNestedObjectCoverage) are two more blocking, mechanically-generated ledgers added 2026-08-04: every enum-constrained property (enum/items.enum/anyOf-oneOf-of-enums) on a mapped, reachable schema that isn't tied to a mapped enums[] symbol, and every inline object/array-item-object shape on one that has no nested[] entry, respectively. Both use the same schema/property/reason/owner shape and the same dotted-path (schema, nested SDK symbol for depth>=2) conventions as properties[]/enums[] above. The 2026-08-04 baseline entries were generated programmatically from the first clean run of both checks against the then-current spec, each carrying reason 'baseline 2026-08-04: not yet modeled, needs review' -- an honest placeholder, not a judgment that the gap is fine to leave forever; each is a real, greppable backlog item for a human to triage (either add the map entry or write a real reason).
